verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud application platform, so edge/serverless WebSocket handling is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack never mentions WebSockets, persistent connections, or edge/serverless functions. The closest items, a global CDN for static assets and background workers, are adjacent features and do not show this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can handle persistent WebSocket connections from within edge/serverless functions for real-time apps
